response.sql: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Bytes END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS bpm FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm FROM media_stats), kept AS (SELECT m.* FROM media_stats m, overall o WHERE m.bpm > o.avg_bpm) SELECT AVG(k.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(k.bpm) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(k.bpm - o.avg_bpm) AS avg_rate_above_overall FROM kept k, overall o;
